newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms MacMillan Bloedel ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms MacMillan Bloedel ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday that it had reaffirmed its credit ratings for MacMillan Bloedel Ltd following a full review.
CBRS rated MacMillan Bloedel's commercial paper at A-2 (high), senior debt at B++, preferred shares at P-3 and subordinated debentures at B++ (low).
CBRS also assigned a stable rating outlook to the company.

"The ratings reflect the well-established operational presence in solid wood and packaging segments and the gradual improvement of the company's paper operations, which provide a solid base of earnings and cash flow support," CBRS said.
